LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Quebec

Visitors generally need a Quebec sport fishing licence. A licence does not remove the outfitter requirement in specified northern and eastern areas.

  • 1 day$22.36 CAD
  • 3 consecutive days$38.36 CAD
  • 7 consecutive days$57.67 CAD
  • April 1 to March 31$95.68 CAD
